merge_note: The incident editor, the constraint verifier and the four writers (rev, sense, notice, key) are merged under one owner (U1), as plan.md §9 records: the captions are short and coupled to the timing. Operator independence is checked instead by verify.py's one-operator signature: each variant differs from the baseline only in its declared mutable dimensions.

timing_policy.rule: Typed captions (S0 title, S2 log text, S5 key) type at 14 chars/s and are held after typing. Register lines (S1), card lines (S3) and notice fields (S4) are set whole on their event and persist to the end of their shot, so every line is readable; the reason is recorded per variant (reveal_note).
